description: Check a domain's BIMI setup: looks up the default._bimi TXT record, fetches the logo it points to (l=) and validates the SVG against the BIMI SVG Tiny Portable/Secure profile, and reports whether a certificate (a=, VMC or CMC) is referenced. Does not verify the certificate itself or the DMARC policy (BIMI also needs DMARC at enforcement - use check_spoofability for that).
name: check_bimi
title: BIMI record + logo check
